summary: @or-sdk/files preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes 727KB obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. On `npm install`, setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime (v1.3.13) from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, extracts it to a temporary directory, chmods it executable, and uses it to execute the sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB single-line heavily obfuscated bundle (rotated string-array VM, `_0x`-renamed identifiers, dispatch-style control flow) whose content cannot be reconciled with the package's advertised purpose as a OneReach Files API client. The filename `math_init` is unrelated to any documented functionality of a files-API SDK. Downloading an alternate language runtime at install time specifically to execute an opaque obfuscated sibling bypasses Node-focused static analysis and hands install-time control on the installer's machine to attacker-controlled code.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
